about: CP-48 independent hand count for examples/hut5.py (layers drawn there) against storage_index.json. Worked by hand on 2026-10-19, not produced by eve_design. Recipe yields read from the 26.3 jar's recipe files (oak_planks 1 log->4, stick 2 planks->4, oak_stairs 6->4, oak_slab 3->6, oak_door 6->3, crafting_table 4->1, torch coal+stick->4, glass_pane 6 glass->16, glass = smelt 1 sand).

items: planks 11+8+12+9=40; slabs 9 + 4 double x2 = 17; door 2 blocks -> 1 item; bed 2 blocks -> 1 item; wall_torch -> torch
stock (shared+loaded only): cobblestone 13, oak_planks 20, oak_log 6, glass_pane 2, oak_stairs 6, oak_slab 8, white_bed 1, chest 1, coal 2, dirt 1
stairs short 6 -> 2 batches -> 8 (left 2), 12 planks; slabs short 9 -> 2 batches -> 12 (left 3), 6 planks; door short 1 -> 1 batch -> 3 (left 2), 6 planks; table 1 batch, 4 planks

planks demand 40 + 12 + 6 + 6 + 4 + 2 = 70, stock 20 -> short 50 -> 13 batches -> 52 (left 2), 13 logs
logs demand 12 + 13 = 25, stock 6 -> chop 19; cobblestone 25 - 13 -> mine 12; sand -> dig 6; scaffold dirt 2 - 1 -> dig 1
tools: axe 19 (logs), pickaxe 12 (cobblestone), shovel 6 sand + 1 dirt + 2 scaffold removal = 9
carry: 11 final item types + dirt, each fits one stack (bed stacks to 1, count 1) -> 12 slots, 1 trip
